page_summary: This section details specific reductions to planetary Ayurdaya contributions based on astrological conditions like enemy sign placement, combustion, and malefic affliction to the Lagna. It also outlines a method for calculating planetary Ayurdaya based on planetary longitude relative to its exaltation point, with examples for various planets.

rules.condition: A planet is posited in the house of its natural enemy.
rules.effect: The planet's Ayurdaya contribution is reduced by one-third.
rules.implementation: For planets not Mars and not retrograde, apply a 33.33% reduction to their calculated Ayurdaya contribution if they are in an enemy sign.

rules.condition: Mars is posited in the house of its natural enemy.
rules.effect: Mars's Ayurdaya contribution is not reduced.
rules.implementation: Do not apply the enemy sign reduction to Mars.

rules.condition: A planet in retrograde motion is posited in the house of its natural enemy.
rules.effect: The planet's Ayurdaya contribution is not reduced.
rules.implementation: Do not apply the enemy sign reduction to any retrograde planet.

rules.effect: The planet's Ayurdaya contribution is reduced by half.
rules.implementation: For planets not Saturn and not Venus, apply a 50% reduction to their calculated Ayurdaya contribution if they are combust.

rules.effect: Saturn's or Venus's Ayurdaya contribution is not reduced.
rules.implementation: Do not apply the combustion reduction to Saturn or Venus.

rules.condition: Lagna is afflicted by a malefic planet's presence.
rules.effect: A reduction in Ayurdaya contribution is applied.
rules.implementation: Identify malefic planets in Lagna. If conditions for exemption are not met, apply an Ayurdaya reduction. The specific quantum of reduction should be determined by Pindayu rules.

rules.condition: The malefic planet occupying the Lagna is also the Lagnesh (Lagna lord).
rules.implementation: If a malefic in Lagna is the Lagna lord, do not apply the Lagna affliction reduction.

rules.condition: There are multiple malefic planets in the Lagna.
rules.effect: The malefic nearest the cusp receives the reduction.
rules.implementation: When multiple malefics are in Lagna, prioritize the one closest to the cusp for applying the Lagna affliction reduction.

rules.condition: Rahu or Ketu alone are posited in the Lagna.
rules.implementation: If only Rahu or Ketu is in Lagna, do not apply the Lagna affliction reduction.

rules.condition: The malefic planet in Lagna is aspected by a benefic planet.
rules.implementation: If a malefic in Lagna receives a benefic aspect, do not apply the Lagna affliction reduction.

rules.condition: The same planet is subject to more than one Ayurdaya reduction rule.
rules.effect: Only the reduction requiring the highest value is applied.
rules.implementation: For any planet, calculate all applicable Ayurdaya reductions and apply only the single largest reduction.

rules.condition: Calculating a planet's Ayurdaya contribution based on its longitude.
rules.effect: Ayurdaya is calculated from planet's distance to exaltation.
rules.implementation: Implement the Ayurdaya calculation method: (1) Determine the difference between planet's longitude and its exaltation point (e.g., Moon: 1-3-0, Mars: 9-28-0, Mercury: 5-15-0, Jupiter: 3-5-0, Venus: 11-27-0). (2) If this difference is less than 6 Rasis, use it directly. (3) If it's 6 Rasis or more, subtract the difference from 12 Rasis. (4) Multiply the resulting value by the planet's specific multiplier (Moon x 10, Mars x 7, Mercury x 17, Jupiter x 16, Venus x 20) to obtain days, then convert to years, months, and days.
